note: Provenance for the clinical designations tagged on each hospital in hospitals.json (`services`). That file is the single source of truth for WHICH hospital holds WHICH designation; this file records HOW WELL SOURCED each designation type is. TYPE1_ED is derived from aeType === 1 rather than tagged.

tagMeaning.TYPE1_ED: Consultant-led major A&E, 24/7, full resuscitation facilities
tagMeaning.MTC: Major Trauma Centre — receives major trauma, bypassing nearer hospitals
tagMeaning.HASU: Hyper-Acute Stroke Unit — 24/7 thrombolysis and hyper-acute stroke care
tagMeaning.HAC: Heart Attack Centre — 24/7 primary percutaneous coronary intervention

verificationNotes.MTC: London Ambulance Service names all four adult major trauma centres directly: Royal London, St George's, King's College, St Mary's. Primary source.
verificationNotes.HASU: Eight designated London HASUs, consistent across multiple NHS trust sources. King's runs two of the eight.
verificationNotes.HAC: UNCONFIRMED. Trust pages block automated access; secondary sources disagree on whether London has seven or eight heart attack centres. Verify before operational use.
